answer: Practically, the chain should stake the identity's own past earnings as collateral that jurors can slash, because zenith only stays cheap while cloning pays only if the clone survives grading, so the amortized cost of a fleet rises. Concretely, anchor is enforced in the ledger: Independence is measured by who attests to whom, which is expensive to fake at scale. Any glacier approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
